raw_problem.problem_text: 设 $\Psi _ { 1 }$ 与 $\Psi _ { 2 }$ 是薛定谔方程式两个解，证明 $\iiiint _ { \tau } \displaylimits ^ { \cdot } \int \displaylimits _ { \left. \overline { { \left. x , t \right. } } \right. } ^ { \left. \left[ \varphi \right] _ { 1 } \right. } ( \vec { x } , t ) \varPsi _ { 2 } ( \vec { x } , t ) d x ^ { 3 }$ 与时间无关。
raw_problem.solution_text:
[证明]试将此式对时间求偏导数，再利用 $\Psi _ { \mathrm { ~ 1 ~ } } ^ { * }$ ， $\Psi _ { 2 }$ 所满足的薛定谔方程式，有：

$$
\frac {\partial}{\partial t} \iiint_ {\tau} \Psi_ {1} ^ {*} \Psi_ {2} d ^ {3} x = \iiint_ {\tau} \left(\frac {\partial \Psi_ {1} ^ {*}}{\partial t} \Psi_ {2} + \Psi_ {1} ^ {*} \frac {\partial \Psi_ {2}}{\partial t}\right) d ^ {3} x
$$

因 $\mathrm { l } - \hbar i \frac { \partial \Psi ^ { * } { } _ { 1 } } { \partial t } = - \frac { \hbar ^ { 2 } } { 2 m } \nabla ^ { 2 } \Psi ^ { * } { } _ { 1 } + \nabla \Psi ^ { * } { } _ { 1 }$

$$
+ \hbar i \frac {\partial \Psi_ {2}}{\partial t} = - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \nabla^ {2} \Psi_ {2} + \nabla \Psi_ {2}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} \frac {\partial}{\partial t} \iiint_ {\tau} \Psi^ {*} _ {1} \Psi_ {2} d ^ {3} x = \iiint_ {\tau} \frac {\hbar}{2 m i} \left(\nabla^ {2} \Psi^ {*} _ {1} \cdot \Psi_ {2} + \Psi^ {*} _ {1} \cdot \nabla^ {2} \Psi_ {2}\right) d ^ {3} x \\ - \iiint_ {\tau} \frac {1}{\hbar i} \left(\nabla \Psi_ {1} ^ {*} \Psi_ {2} - \cdot \nabla \Psi_ {1} ^ {*} \Psi_ {2}\right) d ^ {3} x \\ = \frac {\hbar}{2 m i} \iiint_ {\tau} \nabla \cdot \left(\nabla \Psi_ {1} ^ {*} \cdot \Psi_ {2} + \Psi_ {1} ^ {*} \cdot \nabla \Psi_ {2}\right) d ^ {3} x \\ = \frac {\hbar}{2 m i} \iint \left(\nabla \Psi_ {1} ^ {*} \cdot \Psi_ {2} + \Psi_ {1} ^ {*} \cdot \nabla \Psi_ {2}\right) \cdot d \vec {s} \\ \end{array}
$$

最后一道等号是利用高斯定理将题给的体积分（τ）变换成（τ）的包围面 S 的面积分，若 $\Psi _ { 1 }$ ， $\Psi _ { 2 }$ 满足平方可积条件

$$
\lim  _ {\vec {r} \rightarrow \infty} \Psi_ {1} = 0, \quad \lim  _ {\vec {r} \rightarrow \infty} \nabla \Psi_ {1} = 0
$$

等，可使这面积分等于零。所以体积分 $\int _ { \tau } \int \displaylimits _ { \tau } \boldsymbol { \mathcal { F } } ^ { \ast } ( \Vec { \boldsymbol { x } } , t ) \boldsymbol { \mathcal { V } } _ { 2 } ( \Vec { \boldsymbol { x } } , t ) d \boldsymbol { x } ^ { 3 }$ 是与时间无关的。
